test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in indirect speech.

The teacher said, “The university will be closed tomorrow.”

options.text: The teacher said that the university will be closing tomorrow.
The teacher asked that the university will be closed the day after
The teacher said that the university would be closed the day after
The teacher said that the university would be closed tomorrow.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In indirect speech, when reporting a statement about future events, the tenses usually shift back one step in time.
 
• "**Will**" changes to "**would**" to indicate future-in-the-past.
 
• Additionally, the time expression "**tomorrow**" changes based on its relative position to the time of reporting.
 
• In this case, "**tomorrow**" becomes "the day after" to maintain the relative temporal relationship.
 
• The punctuations like commas, inverted commas, etc are removed and the connector '**that**' is added.

**Indirect speech:** ***"The teacher said that the university would be closed the day after"***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 is inappropriate as '**will**' is used instead of '**would**'.
 
• Option 2 is inappropriate as '**will**' is used instead of '**would**'.
 
• Option 3 is inappropriate as '**tomorrow**' is used instead of '**the day after**'.
